title: Choosing an EC2 purchasing option

kcs.statement: A steady 24/7 workload expected to run for a year or more belongs on Reserved Instances or Savings Plans, while a short-lived or unpredictable workload belongs on On-Demand.
A common cost-optimal fleet covers the steady baseline with Savings Plans or RIs, the peaks with On-Demand, and interruptible extra work with Spot.
Relative saving = 1 − (discounted hourly rate ÷ On-Demand hourly rate); for example $0.06 versus $0.10 an hour is a 40% saving, about $350 a year for one instance running all 8,760 hours.

problem_ideas: A web app needs 4 instances all the time and up to 12 at lunchtime peaks: split the fleet across purchasing options.
